deepdive.thesis: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals is a global specialty pharma company that discovers, manufactures, and markets branded generics and innovative medicines focused on oncology, respiratory, and dermatology, with strong presence in India and regulated markets.

open.item: Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 250% (₹2.5 per equity share of face value ₹1 each) for FY2026, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM, with total cash outflow of approximately ₹705.50 million.
Glenmark has submitted marketing authorization applications for Aumolertinib across 10 markets, with the first commercial launch anticipated during the second half of FY2027.
Glenmark secured regulatory approval to launch Ryaltris® in Brazil, with the launch planned in FY2027.
IGI is targeting one IND (Investigational New Drug) filing every year from FY2027, progressing the next generation of IGI assets towards clinical development.
The UK launch and EU marketing authorization of Winlevi® provides a platform for further expansion across Glenmark's licensed European territories in FY2027.
Glenmark is targeting over 70% revenue contribution from branded markets by FY2030.

IGI's exclusive licensing agreement with AbbVie for ISB 2001 carries a potential aggregate deal value of USD 1.925 Bn (of which USD 700 Mn upfront has been received) plus tiered double-digit royalties on net sales, with Glenmark leading commercialization across Emerging Markets.
Glenmark is targeting 13–15% revenue CAGR over the medium term, driven by increasing contribution from branded and differentiated businesses.
Glenmark is targeting a Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) above 23%, while maintaining a net cash position.
Glenmark is targeting a Return on Equity (ROE) above 20%.
Glenmark is targeting a 35% reduction in absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions and a 28% reduction in Scope 3 emissions intensity by 2035.
Glenmark is advancing towards carbon neutrality by 2030 through renewable energy, energy efficiency, and responsible resource management.

risks.note: The AR flags the 'inherent uncertainty associated with pharmaceutical R&D' as a key risk (categorized as Financial Risk, Strategic Risk): the discovery-to-commercialization journey is lengthy and involves scientific, regulatory, manufacturing and commercial challenges at every stage, and not all development programs will achieve regulatory approval or commercial success, which may affect future revenue generation.
risks.risk: Pharmaceutical R&D and pipeline execution risk

risks.note: Ensuring product quality across manufacturing, packaging, labeling and distribution is identified as essential to consumer trust and brand reputation; the AR states that any instance of failure in product quality would have serious repercussions, particularly as the Company introduces new products and expands into new markets (categorized as Quality Risk).

Glenmark USA continued to defend multiple antitrust and consumer protection lawsuits relating to industry-wide allegations of price-fixing, market allocation and related conduct; it agreed to separate settlements of USD 37.75 Mn with the putative direct purchaser class and USD 29.63 Mn with state attorneys general (the latter payable in annual installments over five years), subject to court approval, while denying the underlying allegations.

The Monroe, North Carolina formulations facility required a U.S. FDA Establishment Inspection Report before commercial manufacturing could restart (resolved with a Voluntary Action Indicated classification in November 2025), illustrating exposure to FDA site-inspection outcomes. As of March 31, 2026 the Company also had 52 applications pending at various stages of the U.S. FDA approval process, including 25 Paragraph IV applications, an unresolved regulatory-approval pipeline.
risks.risk: U.S. FDA regulatory and manufacturing-site inspection risk

risks.note: Emerging Markets (Russia/CIS, LATAM, MEA, APAC) performance in FY2026 was affected by seasonal demand patterns, geopolitical uncertainties and delayed launches in selected markets, particularly in the first half, indicating structural exposure to geopolitical and macro volatility across the Company's international footprint.
risks.risk: Geopolitical and demand-volatility exposure in Emerging Markets

risks.note: The August 2025 GST regime change caused a pronounced one-time impact to India formulation sales in Q2 FY2026, contributing to a reported 17.0% decline in India business revenue for FY2026 despite strong underlying secondary-sales demand, showing sensitivity to domestic tax-policy transitions.

Glenmark's risk governance disclosure states that, as a pharmaceutical company with a global geographic footprint, it is 'inherently exposed to a diverse set of risks including geopolitical complexity and scientific advancements,' managed through an Enterprise Risk Management Framework overseen by the Board's Risk Management Committee.
